vms.touch.keyboardHint: Opens the phone's keyboard; what you type goes to the VM.
vms.touch.fkeysHint: Shows the function keys F1 to F12
vms.touch.trackpadHint: Trackpad: a finger moves the pointer, a tap clicks, a two-finger tap is a right click, two fingers drag to scroll, tap and drag at once to drag with the button held.
vms.touch.directHint: Direct: a tap clicks where it lands, a two-finger tap is a right click, two fingers drag to scroll, a long press is a right click.
